upgrades_tab.title: Upgrades
upgrades_tab.description:
Upgrades sim swaps in each included item one at a time, comparing the result to your current gear. Run it to get a ranked list of upgrades.
This is an Alpha feature (currently DPS-only), so if you have feedback or find a bug, please report it!
upgrades_tab.eligible_count_unknown: No ranking data for this spec

status.idle: Ranks upgrades against your current gear and settings on this page.
status.unsupported_spec: This spec has no ranking data yet.
status.error_sim_unavailable: Something went wrong running the sim. Refresh the page.
status.stale: settings changed since this ranking — results may be out of date
status.stale_hint: Run again to rank with the current settings.
status.stopped: Stopped early. Your current gear: {{dps}} DPS. No candidate rows to show — run again for a full ranking.
status.stopped_partial: Stopped early. Your current gear: {{dps}} DPS. The rows below finished before Stop.

view.title: View options
view.set_potential_tooltip: When on, a set piece's DPS gain includes the gain of equipping the other set pieces its set bonus needs, if that adds to the total.
view.only_bis_tooltip: Show only items on the phase's curated BiS list. {{phase}} list

export.title: JSON export
export.caveat: Copy the upgrades above as JSON.

export.flavour_tokens: Exporting the token ID for tier pieces — the item that actually drops.
export.flavour_gear: Exporting the gear item ID for every row.

cutoff.pct_arm_title: Above the cutoff via the percentage arm ({{pct}}%): its absolute DPS is below the {{abs}} DPS threshold.
